checklists.contexto: Para prepararte antes de dar un discurso.

items.texto: Sabé tu tema mejor que tu público
items.cita: Know your subject better than your hearers know it, and you have nothing to fear. After Preparing for Success, Expect
Practise, practise, PRACTISE in speaking before an audience will tend to remove all fear

items.texto: Vivía con tu tema hasta estar convencido
items.cita: Live with your subject until you are convinced of its importance. If your message does not of itself arouse you
warn the student that he must be natural. To be natural may be to be monotonous.
